purpose.zh: 练单腿浅蹲时的稳定控制
purpose.en: Build control in a shallow single-leg squat.

text.zh: 支撑腿微蹲，另一只脚向前、侧、后点地
text.en: Bend the standing knee a little and tap the other foot front, side and back

text.zh: 骨盆保持水平朝前，手轻扶椅子
text.en: Keep your pelvis level and facing forward, hand lightly on the chair.

text.zh: 点地要轻，不把重量移到点地脚
text.en: Tap lightly without shifting weight onto the reaching foot.

commonErrors.en: Letting the standing knee cave in.
Putting your weight on the reaching foot.

cautions.zh: 扶稳无轮的椅子，疼痛或站不稳时就停止
cautions.en: Hold a stable chair without wheels, and stop if it hurts or you feel unsteady.
